application_credentials.description: SolarEdge Site Access uses OAuth 2.0. Sign in to the [SolarEdge developer console]({developer_console}) with your mySolarEdge account, create a Site Access application with the SITE_DATA and DEVICE_DATA scopes, and set its Redirect URI to exactly `{redirect_url}` (SolarEdge always redirects to the registered URL, and Home Assistant must be reachable at it from your browser; it is built from your external URL, or your internal URL if none is set). Enter the Client ID and the Client Secret (shown only once) here. The [Homeowner and Self-Access Guide]({self_access_guide}) walks through each screen.

user.title: Choose the SolarEdge access type
user.description: Homeowners use Site Access (OAuth). Installers and fleet owners with a Fleet Access application use an App API Key. V1 site API keys do not work with V2.

init.title: Polling and credits
init.description:
Every API call costs one credit. The Free tier allows 2,000 credits a month. With these settings one site uses about {credits} credits in a 30-day month (assuming every selected device family is present). {warning}

Site data (overview and power) is read at the update interval. Each device family you turn on is read at the telemetry interval (inverters and meters) or the storage interval, which follow the update interval when set to 0. Site details, lifetime energy, and alerts are read every six hours, or at the update interval if that is longer; the device inventory every twelve hours.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often production, consumption, and power are read, 15 to 1440 minutes. Costs two credits per update.
data_description.telemetry_inverters: Add inverter sensors. Costs one credit per inverter interval; needs the DEVICE_DATA scope.
data_description.telemetry_meters: Add meter sensors. Costs one credit per inverter and meter interval; needs the DEVICE_DATA scope.
data_description.telemetry_storage: Add battery sensors. Costs one credit per storage interval; needs the DEVICE_DATA scope.
data_description.telemetry_interval_minutes: Minutes between inverter and meter reads, 15 to 1440. 0 follows the update interval.
data_description.storage_interval_minutes: Minutes between battery reads, 15 to 1440. 0 follows the update interval.

error.interval_too_short: Use 0 to follow the update interval, or at least 15 minutes. SolarEdge data has 15-minute resolution.

credit_limit.title: SolarEdge monthly API credits used up
credit_limit.description: SolarEdge refused updates for site {site_id} because the developer account has no monthly credits left. Updates retry every six hours and resume when the billing cycle resets. To avoid this, raise the update intervals or turn off device telemetry in the integration options, or move the developer account to a higher tier.

device_scope_missing.title: SolarEdge device telemetry not permitted
device_scope_missing.description: SolarEdge refused device telemetry for site {site_id}. Site Access tokens need the DEVICE_DATA scope. Reconfigure the entry and approve both scopes, or turn off device telemetry in the options. Site sensors keep working.
